missingness.missing_input_ids: exactly policy-required input IDs absent from bindings
missingness.present_input_ids: exactly the binding object keys, sorted lexicographically

provenance.source_case_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact source-case file bytes supplied to the builder
provenance.policy_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact policy file bytes supplied to the builder
provenance.source_case_identity: source_case_id and case_id are explicit; neither is inferred from prose

mapping_declaration.bindings_representation: array so duplicate input IDs remain detectable
mapping_declaration.source_pointer_format: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the explicit source-case object

policy_input_declarations.unitless_is_explicit: unit null must match policy unit null

binding_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false
binding_digest.digest_input: complete binding object excluding no fields; binding object does not contain binding_sha256

route_evaluation.typed_equality: JSON value and declared type must both match; boolean is not integer

condition_set_reduction.NO_MATCH: at least one condition evaluates NO_MATCH
condition_set_reduction.MISSING_INPUT: no condition is NO_MATCH and at least one condition evaluates MISSING_INPUT

route_input_ids.evaluated_input_ids: sorted present policy-required IDs available to any selector or stop condition
route_input_ids.missing_input_ids: sorted policy-required IDs absent from the binding

precedence: Evaluate every stop condition; only MATCH counts as a matched stop.
Evaluate every selector rule; only MATCH counts as a matched selector.
Exactly one matched stop and zero matched selectors selects stop.
Exactly one matched selector and zero matched stops selects selector.
Zero matched stops and zero matched selectors selects fallback, including when inputs are missing.
More than one matched stop, more than one matched selector, or any stop-selector combination fails closed as ROUTE_AMBIGUOUS.

natural_language_boundary.marker_effect: fail closed as INTERFACE_CONFLICT; do not emit a route trace
natural_language_boundary.prose_role: visible for natural-language answer generation only

route_trace.selector: selected rule and exact action_ref; every selected condition is MATCH
route_trace.stop: selected stop_id, null action ID; every selected condition is MATCH
route_trace.fallback: null rule/action IDs; zero matched stops and selectors; missing inputs may exist
route_trace.ambiguous_or_interface_conflict: no valid route trace is emitted
